TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Arafura Sea
DATE 28 November 2028 · 0620 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 65 min, closes at 98
Hobart class. Photo: 海上自衛隊 · CC BY 4.0 · cropped

ARAFURA SEA. The ceasefire came into effect at 0000 on 27 November, and the first convoy sails at first light today because insurers move faster than diplomats. CORAL PIONEER is at the head of it, with a bearing running hot and nine knots she can hold.

There are two Chinese naval groups in the box. One has acknowledged its withdrawal order and is heading north at steady speed. The other has not acknowledged anything since 0400 and, if FUJIAN is still afloat, has a maritime strike flight within range.
Tell them apart. Get the convoy home. Do not be the incident that restarts this - a withdrawing ship you sink today is the reason the ceasefire fails before this convoy reaches port.
Commodore Alex Mercer
COMMANDER'S INTENT
Coral Pioneer, nine knots, one shaft. Tell the two groups apart before you fire: the ceasefire is what six weeks were for, and one mistake today reopens all of it.
• Bring three of the four merchants, Coral Pioneer among them, into Darwin's approaches
• Do not sink a withdrawing ship
• Bring the escorts home
Your escort group with HMAS Eyre attached, a Poseidon, and four merchant hulls. Two Chinese groups: one withdrawing, one not. A Wedgetail is up.

The planned window is 65 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 33 minutes more; the operation is closed at 98 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
